Title: LSJ- The Jones versus Flash Grenade

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
So my Nakhthorheb is in combat with the imbued, Travis. Travis
conceals out a Flash Grenade and strike S:CE with it. Nakhthorheb
plays the Jones at superior to cancel the strike. Does the Flash
Grenade burn with no effect, or does it stay? If it stays, then can
Travis just choose to strike with the same Flash Grenade again?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

>> It stays, and it can be chosen again.
>
> Does the same go for a gun and Dragon Breath rounds?

It would, except Jones is played as the strike card is played.

So it can be used on in-play strikes, so scratch my answer above -- the set-up
is not legal: can't use The Jones against a Flash Grenade (nor a .44).

Messages.Author: agzocgud
Messages.Body:
>
> So could you use the Jones when a Thrown Gate or Aid From Bats is
> played for a manuever?
>

Sure, cancels as it is played (card text). Doesn´t matter when the
strike card is played. Simillar, the Jones would not work against
Shroud of abscense (superior), which is not a strike card, just a way
to get a strike (just like flash grenade).

Jones, The
Type: Combat
Requires: Serpentis
Only usable in combat with an ally or younger vampire.
[ser] Strike: dodge, with an optional press, only usable to end
combat.
[SER] Cancel the opposing minion's strike card as it is played. (No
cost is paid, and the minion chooses another strike). A vampire may
play only one The Jones at superior each round.
